== Title ==
<span lang="ja">急襲</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費して、1つの場所のフォース消耗を、キャンセルできる。相手の持つキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークル、一つごとに、運命数を1枚引く。引いた運命数の合計と、相手の戦闘力の合計を比較する。低いほうが、その差の分だけフォースを失う。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">厳格な軍規の元に行動する帝国軍兵士達は、反乱軍の機転をきかせた待ち伏せ、突然の反撃、妨害行動に、しばしば不意をつかれた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Surprise Assault]].

'''Lore''' — Imperial soldiers acting under strict military rules were often caught off guard by Rebel ambushes, sudden counterattacks, and sabotage.

'''Game text''' — Spend 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at one location. Draw one destiny for each of the opponent's characters, starships, and vehicles. Compare that destiny total to the opponent's power total. The player with the lower total loses Force equal to the difference.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese does not require the opponent's cards to be present. English draws destiny for each character, starship and vehicle the opponent has present. Lore names sudden counterattacks instead of sneak attacks.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-surpriseassault.gif|Original English face]], [[Surprise Assault]].</ref>
